insights: The 1.74 cap binds, so any price above it is replaced by 1.74. Firm B matches my price. Demand is inelastic here: cutting the price from 1.74 to 1.60 raised volume only about 7% (42.49 to 45.42) while the margin fell 19% (0.74 to 0.60), so profit dropped from 31.44 to 27.25. 1.74 is the best known price, and its result is stable at 31.44 across many rounds. Higher prices look likely to pay off because elasticity is low and no customer pays above 4.51. They can only be tested if the cap rises.

The competitor matches our price, or the same limit applies to both. Rounds 4-29 confirmed the results are repeatable (31.44 at 1.74).
